title: Simplify Path
description: Convert an absolute file path to its canonical simplified form.

data.text: Given a string `path` representing an absolute Unix-style path, simplify it and return the canonical path.

data.title: Build string O(n^2)
Stack O(n)
What improved?
data.text: A stack naturally models directory hierarchy. `..` pops the last directory, `.` is ignored, and valid names are pushed. The final join reconstructs the path.
